Higher Education Committee
Thursday, March 30, 2023
3:00 PM, Room G-15, Capitol

Minutes

Present: Senator Omar Fateh - Chair, Senator Aric Putnam Vice Chair, Senator Zach Duckworth, Senator Robert D. Farnsworth,
Senator Robert J. Kupec, Senator Erin P. Murphy, Senator Clare Oumou Verbeten, Senator Jason Rarick

Absent: No Members Absent

Senator Omar Fateh called the meeting to order at 3:00pm

S.F. 2075: Senator Fateh: Funding and policy related changes provision for the Office of Higher Education, Minnesota State
Colleges and Universities, the University of Minnesota and the Mayo Clinic.

Chair Fateh moved the A-5 amendment, which passed on a voice vote.

Chair Fateh moved the A-6 amendment, which passed on a voice vote.
Senator Rarick moved the A-7 amendment, which passed on a voice vote.
Senator Rarick moved the A-8 amendment, which did not pass on a voice vote.
Senator Rarick moved the A-9 amendment, which passed on a voice vote.

Senator Duckworth moved the A-4 amendment, which did not pass on a voice vote.

Chair Fateh moved that SF 2075 be recommended to pass as amended and be re-referred to the Committee on Finance, which
passed on a voice vote.

Senator Fateh moved that S.F. 2075, as amended, recommended to pass and re-referred to the Finance Committee. - MOTION
ADOPTED.

The meeting was adjourned at 4:13
